findings.label: Spec-vs-Figma contradiction on open-trigger
findings.detail: The source-of-truth spec prose describes the FAQ open trigger as 'navy with inverse text,' but Figma node 656:7304 (verified via get_screenshot + get_variable_defs) shows a light trigger with navy text and a navy chevron badge. The code correctly follows Figma, not the prose. The spec prose should be corrected to avoid future confusion; no code change needed.

findings.label: Trigger padding not bumped to Figma's 24
findings.detail: Figma's FAQ trigger uses padding 24 (Cards Tokens/Padding Large); the implemented trigger keeps the pre-existing px-4 py-4 (16px). This is pre-existing resting styling outside the hover spec's scope (the spec only mandates padding 24 for the answer panel, which is implemented via p-6). Informational, not blocking.

findings.label: No test for hover/open visual states
findings.detail: The hover-driven CTA promotion and open/hover color classes are CSS-only and not asserted by the existing suite; a regression in the class strings would not be caught by tests. Acceptable for a presentational change verified visually against Figma.
